start.kicker: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 · Space Mission Design Game
start.tagline: Lead a real science mission: split the budget, build a CubeSat, cross space on finite fuel and get into orbit. Every decision has consequences.

levels.title: Choose a level
levels.intro: Each level is a stage of designing a real mission. Complete one to unlock the next.

mission.title: Mission & budget
mission.desc: Set the science objective and split the budget across the mission's 4 segments.

workshop.title: CubeSat Workshop
workshop.desc: Assemble your satellite within mass, volume and power limits.

journey.title: Cruise & insertion
journey.desc: Travel on finite fuel and perform the braking burn to enter orbit.

report.title: Maturity report
report.desc: Get your science data and your design's CML maturity level.
